questiontext.text:
A questionnaire on housing arrangements showed this information obtained from \({@total@}\) respondents to represent the data (H = house, A = apartment, M = mobile home, C = condominium).

\({@list@}\)

Use the information provided above to answer the following questions:

a. Fill in the table below

house apartment mobile home condominium
housing arrangements [[input:ans1]][[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]] [[input:ans2]][[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]] [[input:ans3]][[validation:ans3]][[feedback:prt3]] [[input:ans4]][[validation:ans4]][[feedback:prt4]]
angles [[input:ans5]][[validation:ans5]][[feedback:prt5]] [[input:ans6]][[validation:ans6]][[feedback:prt6]] [[input:ans7]][[validation:ans7]][[feedback:prt7]] [[input:ans8]][[validation:ans8]][[feedback:prt8]]

b.Which pie chart represents the information above?

Pie chart \(1\) [[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-1.2, 1.2, 1.2, -1.2], keepaspectratio: true, showCopyright: false, axis: false, showNavigation: false }); var centre = board.create('point', [0, 0], { fixed: true, name: "" }); var pie = board.create('circle', [centre, 1], { fixed: true }); var p0 = board.create('point', [0, 1], { fixed: true, visible: false, name: 'p0' }); /*Create endpoint of first sector*/ var an1 = "{#-angle_H_rad#}"; /*Angle of first sector in radians*/ var t1 = board.create('transform', [an1, centre], { type: 'rotate' }); var p1 = board.create('point', [p0, t1], { color: 'blue', visible: false, name: 'p1' }); /*Create endpoint of second sector*/ var an2 = "{#-angle_A_rad#}"; /*Angle of second sector in radians*/ var t2 = board.create('transform', [an2, centre], { type: 'rotate' }); var p2 = board.create('point', [p1, t2], { color: 'blue', visible: false, name: 'p2' }); /*Create endpoint of third sector*/ var an3 ="{#-angle_C_rad#}"; /*Angle of third sector in radians*/ var t3 = board.create('transform', [an3, centre], { type: 'rotate' }); var p3 = board.create('point', [p2, t3], { color: 'blue', visible: false, name: 'p3' }); /* var angles = [an1, an2, an3, 2 * Math.PI - an1 - an2 - an3];*/ var points = [p0, p1, p2, p3, p0]; var sector_names = ["Sector 1", "Sector 2", "Sector 3", "Sector 4"]; var startAngle = 0; for (var i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) { var sector = board.create('sector', [centre, points[i + 1], points[i]], { name: sector_names[i], label: { fontSize: 16 } }); var angle = board.create('angle', [points[i + 1], centre, points[i]], { radius: 0.2, name: function () { return JXG.Math.Geometry.trueAngle(points[i + 1], centre, points[i]).toFixed(0) + '°'; } }); } [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Inorder to get the housing arrangements, you need to count the the number of each housing and to get the angle we use the formula below:

Housing angle \(= \frac{\text{number of housing}}{\text{total number of housing}} \times 360^{\circ}\) as shown in the table below.

house apartment mobile home condominium
housing arrangements \({@aa@}\) \({@bb@}\) \({@cc@}\) \({@dd@}\)
angles \({@angle_H@}\) \({@angle_A@}\) \({@angle_C@}\) \({@angle_M@}\)

The pie chart represented above is :
